abort.not_admin: Only administrators can install this integration.

init.title: Trip settings
init.description: Configure optional driver and category controls. Only administrators can define the available category names. Use unique, non-empty names without surrounding spaces. Removed categories remain on previously categorized trips. Defaults continue to apply while controls are hidden; assigned trips are not overwritten. On the next page, select category defaults per vehicle.

category_defaults.title: Default categories per vehicle
category_defaults.description: Select one or more categories for each vehicle. Defaults apply to new trips and backfill trips without categories, even when controls are hidden. Clear a selection to remove that vehicle's default without changing categorized trips.

error.invalid_driver: Choose an existing Home Assistant person for each vehicle.
error.invalid_categories: Use unique, non-empty category names without surrounding spaces.
error.invalid_category_defaults: Select only categories from the available list for known vehicles.
